items.title: Marriott International Earnings Ahead: What Past Reactions Say About The Stock
items.summary: Marriott International (NASDAQ:MAR) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, November 2, 2026. The company has a market value of about $105.5 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $26.9 billion in revenue and $4.2 billion in operating profit, with net income of $2.6 billion.

items.title: HLT Q3 deep dive: business travel and new development drive growth, margin expands
items.summary: Correction: A previous version of this article incorrectly identified Savneet Singh as Hilton’s new Chief Technology Officer. The correct name is Jeff Moore. We have corrected the error in this version of the article.Hotel company Hilton (NYSE:HLT) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 6.6% year on year to $3.33 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.45 per share was 3.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: The top 5 analyst questions from Hilton’s Q3 earnings call
items.summary: Hilton’s third quarter saw revenue growth of 6.6% year-over-year, but sales came in below Wall Street’s expectations. Despite this, management highlighted robust demand in both business and group travel segments, with CEO Christopher Nassetta crediting a “C-shaped economy” and resilient U.S. middle-class wage growth for driving occupancy and rate gains.
